newb-marketplace.note: The builder's marketplace connector (lobby OAuth): browse with search_agents / get_agent, publish with request_publish. Connecting this server IS the sign-in — there is no separate publish auth.

newb-dev.note: Run the expert's agent LOCALLY, before publishing: dev_use to point at a bundle, dev_call to talk to it as a customer would, dev_check to prove it stands on its own declarations, dev_pull to fetch one you already published. First launch installs the dev server and is slow; later launches are instant.
